name: Innoc2Scam-bench
description:
🆕 New Update (2025 Jan)!
	

We conducted human validation on Innoc2Scam-bench and removed many non–developer-style prompts to better focus the benchmark on code-generation tasks.

	
		
		🆕 New Update (2024 Nov)!
	

We’ve just released a comprehensive tutorial on how to use Innoc2Scam-bench!👉 View the tutorial on Hugging Face

	
		
		Innoc2Scam-bench: Organized Results
	

This repository contains the Innoc2Scam-bench dataset and organized evaluation outputs for seven recent LLMs.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/anonymous-author-32423/Innoc2Scam-bench.
evaluation_method: pass@k / functional correctness (unit-test-based) and human_eval for complex cases
reputation: A community dataset hosted on Hugging Face with experiments and organized results for several recent LLMs; modest but growing attention among code-evaluation datasets.
